title: DataArtifact Manifest
description: Normative schema for data-artifact/2.0 manifests. Authoritative source: docs/ontology/artifact/data_artifact.md §顶层语法.

quality.$comment: Optional; ABSENT means unassessed (SP-ADR-105 D-2 default) — not in `required` so pre-existing manifests stay valid. Channel-level granularity and channel->dataset aggregation are allocated to the fyo mapping batch (SP-ADR-105 D-5, platform ledger W-1.3); until it lands this field carries the DATASET-level state only. Human re-assessment goes through the IR Diff controlled-write path (FR-12/FR-14).

storage_uri.description: Byte-stream location URI (s3:// / file:// / oci:// / nfs:// etc.).

data_type.description: DataTypeExpr (atomic / Array<T> / Map<K,V> / Tuple<...> / record / Union / Optional / Function); subset of artifact-dsl-workflow-data-type.

schema_ref.description: Optional URI to remote schema descriptor (parsed at runtime).

lineage.description: Optional provenance lineage (producer workflow run + parent DataArtifact references). Schema TBD by SDD DR-DATA-LINEAGE.

companion_files.description: G1: CWL File.secondaryFiles round-trip channel. Each entry binds a sibling-of-storage_uri pattern.

pattern.description: Relative-to-storage_uri pattern; supports ${basename} / ${ext} placeholders (e.g., '${basename}.bai', '^.tbi'). MUST NOT contain '..' or absolute path.

format_uri.description: G2: CWL File.format round-trip channel. EDAM ontology / IANA media type / Lifted format hint URI list.
